source_scope: Hourly constants read at the pinned revision; historical embedded profile, not fresh provider telemetry. Complete source-file bytes not copied or locally hash-verified.
assumptions: Capacity-only FIFO control, not production value-first/new/backfill allocator.
No rate-limit bypass or account creation: no real source or network calls.
Every selected item takes one quota slot and otherwise completes instantly.
Empty quota usage and backlog at simulation start; 28-day warmup.
Synthetic Poisson arrivals and optional daily gamma shocks are NOT estimated from historical samples.
Eligible fractions are randomly thinned controls, not observed rights or relevance coverage.
All accounts share one upstream; common outage affects every allowance.
Pseudo-local 24-hour days use profile hours; no DST/calendar correctness claim.
Modeled acquisition latency excludes discovery lag, download duration, extraction, model processing and publication.
